name: Floating Point Comparison
hint: The finder detects exact equality checks that use measured or calculated values such as positions, distances, direction, volume, timer, or mouse coordinates. These values are often fractional or change continuously, so they may rarely equal the compared number exactly and a condition or loop can fail unexpectedly.
instruction: Replace the exact equality test with a tolerance or range check, such as comparing with <= or >=, or use a sensing condition that expresses the intended contact.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(timer) = (mouse x)> then
move (10) steps
end

examples.label: Possible solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(timer) < (mouse x)> then
move (10) steps
end
